title: Fix mobile loading skeleton hang by surfacing actor initialization errors + retry UI

requirements.summary: Ensure actor initialization failures/long-running initialization resolve to an error state within a bounded time instead of keeping the skeleton visible indefinitely on mobile.
acceptanceCriteria: When loading the app on mobile and the backend/agent/actor initialization fails, the UI exits the skeleton state and shows an error banner/message within a bounded time (e.g., <= 15 seconds) rather than displaying the skeleton indefinitely.
If actor initialization succeeds, the skeleton transitions to the authenticated view and monthly totals/habit grid rendering without requiring a manual refresh.

file_operations.description: Create a safe wrapper hook that initializes the backend actor with a hard timeout (e.g., 15s) and exposes deterministic error + retry state; mirror the existing actor creation behavior (authenticated + anonymous), while avoiding modifications to the immutable frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts.

Switch habit queries to depend on the new useActorWithTimeout hook so actor initialization errors/timeouts propagate into React Query error state (instead of indefinite loading); keep retries disabled for the habits query and ensure loading reflects bounded actor initialization.

Update the main view to consume the new actor initialization error state (via useHabits or the actor wrapper) and render an error state when actor initialization fails/timeouts, ensuring skeleton rendering is only shown during an active, bounded attempt.

requirements.summary: Provide a user-visible error screen with a primary Retry action that re-attempts actor initialization and refetches habits without closing the tab.
acceptanceCriteria: When a loading error occurs, the screen shows an error message (not a skeleton) and a Retry button.
Tapping Retry triggers a new attempt to initialize the actor (if needed) and refetch habits, and the UI reflects success or failure accordingly.

file_operations.description: Extend the error UI to include clear English recovery guidance and a primary Retry button (use shadcn-ui Button + Alert composition; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing). Accept an optional onRetry callback and render the action when provided.

Expose a retry/recovery function from useHabits (or a separate exported helper) that triggers actor re-initialization retry (via the wrapper hook) and refetches habits; ensure it can be called from the UI without requiring a full reload.

Wire the Retry action into the error UI shown during load failures so that tapping Retry re-attempts actor initialization and then refetches habits, updating the view to either data or error accordingly.

requirements.summary: Refactor main view loading logic so error states take precedence and the skeleton is only shown during bounded loading attempts for authenticated users.
acceptanceCriteria: For an authenticated user, if the habits query cannot run because actor initialization errored, the error UI is shown (not the auth notice and not the skeleton).
For an authenticated user, the skeleton is only shown during an active, bounded loading attempt; afterward the UI resolves to either data or an error UI.

file_operations.description: Reorder and tighten conditional rendering: show AuthRequiredNotice only when unauthenticated; for authenticated users, show error UI first (actor init error or habits query error), then skeleton only while actively loading within the bounded window, and finally render the habit manager/grid when fetched.

Adjust skeleton usage expectations (if needed) to ensure it is only used for active loading states and does not appear as a fallback for unresolved/unknown states; keep composition-only (do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui).
